issue.title: Issue with `fullTemplateTypeCheck` and `ng serve`

issue.body:
# 🐞 Bug report ### Command (mark with an `x`) ``` - [ ] new - [ ] build - [x] serve - [ ] test - [ ] e2e - [ ] generate - [ ] add - [ ] update - [ ] lint - [ ] xi18n - [ ] run - [ ] config - [ ] help - [ ] version - [ ] doc ``` ### Is this a regression? I don't know. ### Description When having `fullTemplateTypeCheck` enabled in `tsconfig.json` and running `ng serve` everything runs fine initially. I might, for example, get nice error messages about my template type-check issues (with colors and everything :smiley:): ``` ERROR in src/app/app.component.html:38:66 - error TS2322: Type 'SearchResults | null' is not assignable to type 'SearchResults | undefined'. Type 'null' is not assignable to type 'SearchResults | undefined'. 38 ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ src/app/app.component.ts:23:16 23 templateUrl: './app.component.html', ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Error occurs in the template of component AppComponent. ``` Then on re-compiling (e.g. after editing a file and saving), I get the following error: ``` ERROR in ./src/main.ts at plugin.done.then ([...]\angular\aio\node_modules\@ngtools\webpack\src\loader.js:41:31) at process._tickCallback (internal/process/next_tick.js:68:7) ERROR in ./src/polyfills.ts Module build failed (from ./node_modules/@ngtools/webpack/src/index.js): Error: [...]\angular\aio\src\polyfills.ts is missing from the TypeScript compilation. Please make sure it is in your tsconfig via the 'files' or 'include' property. at AngularCompilerPlugin.getCompiledFile ([...]\angular\aio\node_modules\@ngtools\webpack\src\angular_compiler_plugin.js:918:23) at plugin.done.then ([...]\angular\aio\node_modules\@ngtools\webpack\src\loader.js:41:31) at process._tickCallback (internal/process/next_tick.js:68:7) i ｢wdm｣: Failed to compile. ``` I might then get some error template type-check errors, but not as nicely formatted (or colorful) as before: ``` ERROR in src/app/app.component.html(38,66): error TS2322: Type 'SearchResults | null' is not assignable to type 'SearchResults | undefined'. Type 'null' is not assignable to type 'SearchResults | undefined'. src/app/app.component.html(47,63): error TS2322: Type 'NavigationNode[]' is not assignable to type 'Option[]'. Type 'NavigationNode' is not assignable to type 'Option'. Types of property 'title' are incompatible. Type 'string | undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'. Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'. src/app/app.component.html(47,87): error TS2322: Type 'NavigationNode' is not assignable to type 'Option'. src/app/custom-elements/api/api-list.component.html(24,8): error TS2322: Type 'ApiSection[] | null' is not assignable to type 'ApiSection[] | Iterable | undefined'. ... ``` After this first error, the app is not re-compiled when I make changes (I have to stop the process and run `ng serve` anew). (NOTE: The error seems only (or much more often) happen when there _are_ template type-check errors.) ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction It started happening for me in PR angular/angular#32980. To reproduce, you could: 1. Check out the PR. 2. Reset to the commit before ``build(docs-infra): enable `fullTemplateTypeCheck` (and fix failures)`` (currently https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/32980/commits/3f228a626). 3. Add `fullTemplateTypeCheck: true` in `aio/tsconfig.json > angularCompilerOptions`. 4. Run `yarn --cwd=aio && yarn --cwd=aio start`. _(You should see some nice template type-check error messages.)_ 5. Open `aio/src/app/app.component.ts`, make a change and save it. _(You should see the error.)_ (NOTE: If that reproduction isn't helpful, I can try to create a minimal one with a new app.) ## 🌍 Your Environment (NOTE: I am on 9.0.0-next.8 now, but this happened with 9.0.0-next.6 as well.) 

Angular CLI: 9.0.0-next.8
Node: 10.16.3
OS: win32 x64
